title: Find Duplicate File in System
goal: Group file paths whose stored contents are identical.
strategy: Parse each directory record into file names and their parenthesized contents. Contents become hash keys; append full paths to their group and emit only groups containing at least two files.

phasePurposes.start: Group file paths whose stored contents are identical.

edgeCases: Identical filenames with different contents are not duplicates
Every distinct content group can remain a singleton
